utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Sam, I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I could really use a few helpers. Would you be able to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa — I can help out on Saturday at the front porch. Just let me know what you’d like me to do.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still lining up helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. If you know anyone handy, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still in for Saturday on the front porch, and I’ll pass along anyone handy I know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I’m still organizing the repair drive for Saturday out front. If you’re free, I could really use the help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit worried about the setup and where we’ll keep everything on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — I’ll ask around and send anyone handy your way. Hope the porch crew fills up soon!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren — I appreciate it. If you hear from anyone handy, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina — I could really use a few helpers this Saturday out front. If you’re free, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help for a bit on Saturday. What time should I come by the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam. I’ll put you down for Saturday on the front porch and send the timing once I’ve got the last details sorted.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Pia — I’m happy to help on Saturday. Just send me the time when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Oren, I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch and could really use a few helpers. If you’re free, I’d love to count you in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I might be able to help, Rosa, though I’m a bit forgetful these days. I’ll try to stop by Saturday on the front porch and see what I can do.
